Initial release of real-estate-autos-research.

- Enables home and used car research via Crawlora API, aggregating Zillow, Redfin, CarMax, Autotrader, and Cars.com data.
- Supports property and vehicle search, price estimates, market trends, and detailed listing lookups.
- Provides normalized JSON responses without scraping.
- Includes guidance for API setup, usage examples, and important notes on required parameters and endpoint coverage.
